description: Windows 10 / 11 client SYN, window 65535 (the majority variant), MSS 1460

provenance.notes: SYN traits attested by real traffic in the Zardaxt public database (profiles/reference/tcp_public.json): layout MNWNNS 82%, window 65535 66% (70% among canonical sessions), scale 8 82%, TTL 128 81%, no ECN 99%, nonzero IP ID 98%. The window split 65535 vs 64240 does not depend on MSS in that data. p0f lists the same layout for NT 6.x. IP ID host counter: public data shows only that it is nonzero, not how it counts. Retransmits 1, 3, 7, 15 s: Catchpoint (Windows 10); Thales documents a 3 s RTO and 2 retransmits, so sources disagree. Window scale dropped from the 2nd retransmission: Clavister KB; p0f lists mss,nop,nop,sok for that layout. Capture a real device with `lb-fptest tcp-capture --flow` to settle the unverified parts.
